parsed.explanation: Thin dossier, so I extrapolate from structure rather than defaulting to the middle. Positives: no criminalisation of same-sex conduct (secondary for trans visitors anyway), a constitutional equality guarantee since 2018 (orientation only; gender identity reach unstated), and no documented trans-specific offence, border screening, facility ban, custody rule, police targeting or violence. Negatives: a 2015 national report records societal stigma toward LGBT people—dated, general, tier-4/5 social-friction-to-hostility evidence, not organised targeting; no documented trans-specific acceptance, no demonstrated enforcement of the equality guarantee, and no documented working remedy. No LGR is a resident-facing gap, not a visitor exposure. With no known traveller-facing exposure but no documented positive evidence either, this sits just below the 0.65 tier, whose anchors show demonstrated acceptance or operating remedies.
